18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Paul Tol colorblind-safe palette and monospace count labels (+37) show real intentionality, but the initial view leaves the bottom half of the viewport empty and typographic hierarchy is modest — functional and considered, not yet polished.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Tree topology and categorical color encoding are honest; no quantitative lie factors, truncated baselines, or dual-axis risks apply; descendant counts are correctly computed recursively; minor: node key uses name+depth string instead of a stable id, which is fragile but not deceptive.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() before new transitions and stale x0/y0 positions cause visual snapping when nodes are clicked during the 500ms transition; search is properly debounced at 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly, and no brush/zoom update storms or feedback loops exist.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Single-view tree with progressive disclosure, 6-color rank legend, and search that auto-expands paths keeps cognitive load low — the collapsed default and +N badges manage depth without overwhelming.
